name: Carpet Stretching: Fixing Ripples Without Replacing the Floor

meta-description: Rippled carpet is a stretching failure, not worn-out carpet — a power-stretch restretch fixes it in an afternoon for a fraction of replacement. Honest costs.
post-summary: October 15, 2026 · Ripples mean your carpet was never power-stretched — not that it is worn out — and a restretch fixes them in an afternoon for a fraction of replacement. Power stretch vs knee kick explained, symptom-by-symptom diagnosis, what a restretch involves, and when stretching honestly is not worth it.
